summary: Completed comprehensive frontend-only validation of the redesigned HourOps marketing landing on external preview URL across desktop/tablet/mobile breakpoints, navigation anchors, modal product tour, workflow/timesheet/approvals/reporting/import/workspace interactions, reduced-motion behavior, and core keyboard accessibility flows.

issues: Several informational labels/metadata render at very small sizes (roughly 7-9px in preview cards), which may reduce readability for users on smaller devices.

Optional: run a dedicated automated accessibility audit tool (axe/lighthouse) in CI for contrast and touch-target verification baselines.

Preview boundary behavior in /app/frontend/src/App.js is preserved as intended (/signup and /login show non-auth preview notice, not full auth flow).
No business-logic regressions observed in requested landing-only interactions; interactive sample data behavior is consistent with requirements.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated external preview URL only. All critical requested flows passed: anchors, mobile menu behavior (including Escape + aria-expanded), product tour open/close/tabs/actual screenshots, workflow step transitions, timesheet day+submit/reset, approvals filters/expand/show-all/approve/reset with expected counts, report drilldowns and CSV feedback state update, import review/reset, workspace brand switching, marquee pause/resume, reduced-motion suppression, and basic dialog focus containment.
rca of the issue: Observed console request failures are from environment overlay/telemetry endpoints (e.g., /__emergent_overlay__/report, /cdn-cgi/rum) rather than landing page business logic. No app-breaking runtime errors detected from core marketing interactions.
